notes: ahead_by is the number of commit objects reachable from the branch but not from the baseline main SHA; patch-equivalent commits are not automatically recognized
ZERO_UNIQUE_ANCESTRY is a deletion candidate, not deletion approval; recheck exact ref SHA, protection/PR status, history preservation, and seven-day grace before deletion
Branches sharing an exact head SHA are certified same-tip duplicates; similarly named branches and similar file stats are not certified patch-equivalent
